details:
Our project, Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer, is an educational project designed to introduce young students to the world of astronauts and space exploration.

The project aims to provide an interesting and interactive learning experience where students can understand the basic concepts of astronaut training, mission preparation and space exploration.

It helps students develop critical thinking, creativity, teamwork and problem-solving skills while encouraging their interest in Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics (STEM).

The creative aspect of this project is its astronaut mission training concept, which makes learning about space more engaging and enjoyable rather than relying only on traditional learning methods.

Throughout the development process, our team considered several factors, including safety, affordability, accessibility, creativity and educational value.

Our main goal is to inspire young learners to become more curious about space exploration and encourage them to discover the possibilities of future space missions.
